entries.deviation: Camunda 8.8.44 accepts a sequence flow that leaves an embedded sub-process without validation; BPMN 2.0 forbids it and the engine would not know which scope owns the token, so we reject it with FLOW_CROSSES_SCOPE (verified live 2026-10-28).
